source: BDS 1.26.60.6 Linux, read from the running server's memory once it started (bds-runtime-dump skill): each block state's connection rule, which fences and thin blocks test on their neighbours. groups is a bit set of the connecting block's groups (0 wood fence, 1 nether brick fence, 2 wall, 3 pane or bars), faces a bit set of the sides that accept it (1 << face: down, up, north, south, west, east). A block not listed, or a state with groups -1, has no rule: everything connects to it.
